title: VUA inspection.get (v0.1)
description: Reads one inspection evidence document by identity (full validation in schemas/inspection-evidence/v0.1/inspection-evidence.schema.json). FROZEN v0.1 (proposal 016 arbitration point 2: independent vocabulary row, get/list after the record.get/list precedent; freeze batch 2026-09-13, data role): the freeze hard-preconditions are closed — (1) the production M7 anchor slice landed and accepted (Bridge v3 five-dimension producing operations, c33adb3 → 7d63abe); (2) the core-side store, the read routes (this face implemented verbatim) and the task-driven inspection.requestRun landed and accepted (merge 7a262b8), followed by the data-review revision batch (c914cf2: family-owned INSPECTION_QUERIES_SCHEMA_VERSION unifies the three family replies — ratified by the data role); (3) positive/negative vectors green plus consumer tests in-tree (acquisition inspection_queries_contract + provider-host frame loop); (4) the bilingual protocol document and (5) the docs/REGISTRY.md row land with this freeze batch. The read face returns the evidence body verbatim — the honest detail lives in the document (referenced, never inlined, never re-derived). The document itself is AMF production persistence domain; it never passes through BDL (proposal 016 §5, proposal 011 §5).

inspectionId.description: VUA-generated inspection identity (uuid v7), same identity convention as the production-evidence entry (W23) and the inspection-evidence body schema. Consumers reference it, never re-derive it.

inspectionDocument.description: The inspection evidence document body, validated in full by schemas/inspection-evidence/v0.1/inspection-evidence.schema.json (kept as a loose object here so the method face does not pin a draft sibling's revision detail; the consumer test anchors the double validation).
